analysis: exact endpoint recovery of an orthogonal core inside a fixed step-0 post-GELU activation subspace
basis: deterministic step-0 post-GELU PCA; fixed and non-trainable
decision_rule: select the smallest rank for which both disjoint step-0 basis windows recover at least 2x the registered random 32-stage Givens aggregate and every pilot cell recovers at least 1.5x that baseline
